composition.description: Tokens concatenate left to right. Typical unit: speech-act, role, zero or more actions, targets, constraints, then macros.

compact.when: both peers explicitly negotiate VQX, compatible versions, matching dictionary SHA-256, policy compatibility, and usefulness
compact.parser_mode: explicit compact mode is required for negotiated sessions; auto-detection is discovery-only

local_macros.definition_content: v0.3 definitions may contain global semantic bytes 00-DB only; nested control/local bytes DC-FF fail closed
local_macros.scope: session and peer; never persist across unrelated peers

authorization: Decoding EXECUTE, INSTALL, DIRECT, COMMIT, or any other intent never grants permission. Authorization belongs to the host runtime.
